packages.title: Widgets: normal, binomial, projectile, wave, halflife
packages.notes: Read WIDGETS.md and src/core.js; match src/widgets-math.js style. normal: mu, sigma, a, b; shade between/below/above; probability to 4 s.f.; Phi via erf with error < 1e-7. binomial: n 1-50, p; bars; highlighted range with cumulative probability; mean np, variance np(1-p); optional normal overlay. projectile: speed, angle, launch height 0-20 m, g presets 9.81/9.8/10; range, time of flight, max height; components at a chosen time; launch animation (respect reduced motion); faint previous paths + clear. wave: data-mode single (A, wavelength, f, v = f lambda) | superpose (two waves + resultant) | stationary (string fixed at both ends, harmonic slider, nodes/antinodes); play/pause, paused under reduced motion. halflife: n0, half-life; dashed half-life markers; lambda = ln2/t_half; N at a chosen t; seeded random decay of up to 400 dots vs the smooth curve.

packages.title: Widgets: periodic, molar, ohm, punnett, chisq, units
packages.notes: Do NOT type element data: pip install periodictable, write tools/make_elements.py that outputs src/elements.js (W.ELEMENTS: Z, symbol, British name, Ar to 1 d.p. or [mass number] if no stable isotope, group, period, block, category; configuration computed by Aufbau for Z <= 36 with Cr and Cu exceptions). periodic: 18-column grid + f-block rows, colour by category/block, detail panel, search, scrolls inside its own box on phones. molar: brackets, hydrates (. or ·), coefficients; Mr and % by mass table; friendly errors (Co vs CO). ohm: V, R, internal r; I, terminal p.d., power; simple circuit drawing; I-V line. punnett: monohybrid, dihybrid, X-linked (X^H X^h x X^H Y); gametes, grid, genotype and phenotype ratios. chisq: O/E or ratio like 9:3:3:1; chi-squared, df, critical value at 0.05 for df 1-10 (3.84 5.99 7.81 9.49 11.07 12.59 14.07 15.51 16.92 18.31), conclusion. units: SI prefix table + converter (length, mass, time, volume incl. dm3 and L, energy J/kJ/eV/kWh, pressure Pa/kPa/atm/mmHg, temperature C/K) + standard-form helper.
